##### Project general facts

Edem Villas I is a boutique collection of private villas by BREIG Property on a hillside site. White facades, arched windows and clean lines reinterpret Greek architecture in a tropical setting, and the cascading arrangement of the villas opens views of the ocean, green hills and tropical landscape.

Each villa stands on its own plot with a private swimming pool and garden, complemented by terraces and exploited rooftop areas with lounge seating facing the ocean. The complex includes a commercial area with a reception, a children's playground, a gym, a restaurant and a sauna, and owners can choose to join a rental pool managed by the developer.

Interiors follow a calm palette of white walls, natural stone, light timber and soft textiles. Arched openings, open-plan kitchens with dining islands, serene bedrooms and bathrooms with freestanding tubs create a bright Mediterranean mood throughout. The villas are delivered fully furnished, ready for living or for rental.

##### Parking

Shared parking.

##### Location description and benefits

Nusa Dua is an enclave on the Bukit Peninsula in southern Bali, home to international luxury hotels, spa resorts, golf courses and a world-class convention centre. The neighbouring area of Benoa adds calm beaches, water sports and marina facilities.

Residents have easy access to the Bali Collection shopping centre, Nusa Dua, Pandawa and Melasti beaches, Bukit Pandawa Golf Club and resorts such as The Apurva Kempinski, while the toll road links the peninsula with the airport and the rest of the island.

The premium resort environment and steady flow of international visitors support strong demand for private villa rentals across the peninsula. Property in the area is held on a leasehold basis, which keeps the entry point attractive for investors.
